_: WHERE THIS SCHEMA COMES FROM, as a checkable fact rather than a note. The definition is not ours: it lives BESIDE THE ENCODER in the ollama fork, which is what makes it the definition rather than a copy of one — the same file is also published in the mlbox notes repo, and pinning to that one would have been pinning to a copy. This vendored copy exists because a fresh checkout must be able to generate without the network, and `blob` is what stops it drifting: a git blob id is content-addressed, so `git hash-object src/proto/chat.proto` proves the copy is byte-for-byte the file at that commit offline. `npm run gen-proto -- --check` does that, asks GitHub whether the commit still carries that blob, and says so when upstream has moved on. Do not edit chat.proto: replace it wholesale, update `commit` and `blob`, and re-run the generator.
